title: Volcano with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="lava" cx="50%" cy="60%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF6600"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="mount" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8B6B4A"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5C3D2E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="mountLight" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A8896B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7A5A42"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Volcano body -->
  <polygon points="50,20 10,90 90,90" fill="url(#mount)"/>
  <!-- Left highlight -->
  <polygon points="50,20 10,90 50,90" fill="url(#mountLight)"/>

  <!-- Crater rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="14" ry="5" fill="#5C3D2E"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="22" rx="10" ry="3.5" fill="url(#lava)"/>

  <!-- Lava drips -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="24" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="23" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#FFAA00"/>
  <path d="M43,25 Q42,34 44,38" stroke="#FF6600" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M57,24 Q58,30 56,35" stroke="#FF8C00" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40,58 Q50,70 60,58" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="41" cy="48" rx="4.5" ry="5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="48" rx="4.5" ry="5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="46.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="46.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="56" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF6B6B" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="56" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF6B6B" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Small floating embers -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#FFAA00"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="10" r="1.2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="8" r="1" fill="#FF8C00"/>
</svg>
